snippet.title: A Little Less Desperation Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
When a peaceful farmer is abducted by an alien, he cannot imagine how this experience will turn him into a hero that needs to save the galaxy. Suddenly, alien abduction is funny again.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2761020/A_Little_Less_Desperation/
